parameters.name: AclAction
parameters.description: The action (settings) that Cloud Firewall performs on the traffic in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. Valid values:

parameters.name: AclUuid
parameters.description: The unique identity ID of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number in a paged query. Settings the current page number for paging.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. Fuzzy queries are supported.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: The destination address in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. Fuzzy queries are supported.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language type for requests and responses.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of a member account of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of access control policies for the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall on each page in a paged query. Settings the number of policies per page for paging.

parameters.name: Proto
parameters.description: The protocol type of the traffic in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. Valid values:

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: The enabled status of the access control policy. Valid values:

parameters.name: RepeatType
parameters.description: The recurrence type of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Valid values:

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source address in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. Fuzzy queries are supported.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall. Valid values:
